review.summary: Fixed two critical data integrity bugs that violated acceptance requirements. The database layer is now ready for launch.

findings.title: Float precision loss in price parsing
findings.description: Price parsing used int() to convert floating-point amounts to minor units, causing truncation errors. For example, '19,99 €' parsed as 19.99 * 100 = 1998.999... which truncated to 1998 instead of 1999. This violated REQ-1 (functional correctness) and RISK-2 (buyer shown wrong price). Fixed by using round() instead of int() in all three ingestion paths.

findings.title: Price history silently deleted on listing update
findings.description: upsert_listing used INSERT OR REPLACE to update existing listings, which deletes the old row and inserts a new one with a new ID. Since price_history has ON DELETE CASCADE referencing listings(id), this silently deleted all price history for the listing. This violated REQ-2 (data integrity) and RISK-1 (price history lost). Fixed by using separate INSERT for new listings and UPDATE for existing ones, preserving the row ID and price history.
